subject: Pen test deliverables & GRC upload for Vertex Health (SIG/Q3 questionnaire)
messages:
From: Samantha Lewis <samantha.lewis@vertexhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request for pen test report for Vertex GRC upload

Hi Mina,

We're preparing to complete the SIG assessment and our GRC portal requires the latest penetration test artifact. Can you please provide a redacted copy of Redwood's most recent external penetration test report and a short scope statement we can paste into the questionnaire? Specifically we need:

- Date of test and testing vendor name
- Scope summary (external network vs authenticated app testing, included assets: API endpoints, web dashboard, cloud infra)
- Any environment exclusions (dedicated/private deployments, third-party integrations)
- Remediation status for critical/high findings (either "remediated" with date or "in progress" with ETA)
- Preferred redaction policy / how to request the unredacted report under NDA

Our SIG portal wants the PDF uploaded to the GRC record: https://grc.vertexhealth.com/portal/upload/records/1892. We also ask for a short CSV or spreadsheet mapping findings -> remediation dates where possible.

We need this for our compliance window next week (target completion 2026-02-19). Please let me know if you need an NDA or a secure upload method.

Thanks,
Samantha Lewis
Security Program Manager
Vertex Health

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lewis <samantha.lewis@vertexhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request for pen test report for Vertex GRC upload

Hi Samantha — thanks for the note. Happy to help and we can get the GRC artifact to you this week. Summary below and attached is a redacted PDF + a remediation tracker we keep for customers.

Pen test summary (to use in questionnaire):
- Vendor: NorthStar Security (third-party)
- Test window: 2025-12-08 to 2025-12-20
- Scope: external network and authenticated application penetration test covering the Redwood hosted API endpoints (api.redwood.ai), web Console/dashboard, and primary public-facing authentication flows. Cloud infrastructure (hosted control plane) and managed third-party SaaS integrations were limited to discovery only; no internal corporate networks were tested.
- Exclusions: Dedicated/Dedicated-Private customer environments and on-prem packages were not part of the engagement.

Redaction / access: the attached PDF (RI-202512-pen-test-summary.pdf) is redacted for customer-identifying details and PoC exploit code. We can provide the full, unredacted report under an NDA. I can start a DocuSign NDA if you prefer — link: https://app.docu-sign.example.com/r/NDAs/RI-FULL-REPORT-2025.

Remediation status: I've attached "remediation-tracker-vertex.xlsx" which maps each finding to status. High/critical findings were either remediated or mitigated by configuration changes during December/January; the tracker includes remediation dates where available. If you need a one-line confirmation for the SIG question about whether high/critical findings are remediated, we can provide that.

Upload options: we can upload the redacted PDF + tracker to your GRC portal if you grant us a record upload link or temporary account. Otherwise I can send via secure SFTP.

Let me know your preference and whether you want the short scope paragraph worded differently for the questionnaire.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Security Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- RI-202512-pen-test-summary.pdf (redacted)
- remediation-tracker-vertex.xlsx

From: Samantha Lewis <samantha.lewis@vertexhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Feb 2026 08:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request for pen test report for Vertex GRC upload

Hi Mina,

This is perfect — thank you. Two quick asks before we close the record:

1) Can you provide a one-paragraph scope statement we can paste into the SIG questionnaire Q2.5 (they want vendor name, dates, and a one-sentence scope)?
2) For the high/critical findings please confirm remediation dates (or provide "in progress" + ETA). Our portal requires either exact dates or a planned remediation date to close the item.

If you can upload the redacted PDF and spreadsheet to the portal link below that would speed things up: https://grc.vertexhealth.com/portal/upload/records/1892. HubSpot ticket HS-4729 is tracking this request on our side.

If you need the full report we will sign the standard NDA; please send the DocuSign link and point of contact who will receive the signed doc.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — target is to have this in by 2026-02-19.

Samantha

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request for pen test report for Vertex GRC upload — need remediation confirmation + scope blurb

Dev / Neha — forwarding Vertex's request below. Can you please action the two items Samantha requested?

1) Dev: please confirm remediation dates for all findings marked High/Critical in the tracker attached. If any remain open, provide an ETA and the mitigation steps. We need exact dates or planned dates we can share with Vertex.

2) Neha: can you draft a 1-2 sentence scope statement for the SIG Q2.5 that mentions vendor, dates, and high-level scope (we should mirror wording from the redacted report). I'll review and then upload.

I attached the remediation tracker (remediation-tracker-vertex.xlsx). If helpful I can upload both artifacts to the Vertex GRC link once we have Neha's blurb and Dev's dates.

Thanks — please reply to all so I can forward to Samantha in one shot.
